content.text:
Pretty normal at 28 months. Lots of toddlers get wary of green food right about now. Try putting a tiny portion of something green on his plate next to a food he already likes, and don't ask him to eat it. Seeing it again and again with no pressure is what usually works, and it can take a lot of tries. Let him touch it, smell it, or watch you eat it. Blending spinach into a smoothie or pancakes is a fine side route too.

Also, I can try signing him up for classes now if you say yes. I used to tell you I couldn't. Want me to look for something near Columbus?
